verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs some built-in background automation. Connected repos get automatic product reviews on each pull request, re-run on push (docs-1, docs-25). Feedback submissions are triaged for spam and handed to an agent that fills in the intention and proposes tasks (docs-20, docs-21). Custom automations, however, depend on driving the CLI from external cron, CI or coding agents (docs-6, docs-17). Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/trigger builder or scheduler, documentation of autonomous agent execution beyond proposing tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration.
